# Committed Apple-buffer LZRAVEN/LZMESH differential vectors

Four genuine ASCF v1 archives were generated by the Applesauce CLI using Apple's macOS **27.0.1** buffer codecs on an arm64 `xcode-27` runner (Darwin 27.0.0, Xcode 27.1, rustc 1.99.1). These are exact bytes copied from the CI evidence ZIPs of 10 November 2026, not re-encoded fixtures. The source tree used to encode them was commit `e697b44a096b34271f73b42af784f2f18cb2eb77`.

| Codec | Logical bytes | ASCF SHA-256 | Independent source |
|---|---:|---|---|
| LZMESH | 65,537 | `75c090b5ce7790c1e406ce115eea57fba041ca57da8576ffeb3eadf1cf068f14` | `mrowlinson/lzmesh@8f9d5fd` |
| LZMESH | 131,103 | `73a7850d2bfa2ce356a7f362061d0071058547050a410d480e78353c0f2a767d` | `mrowlinson/lzmesh@8f9d5fd` |
| LZRAVEN | 65,537 | `c363bd0b549ff77f3f572bdd710c3aec156f8057189afc85368f06bdcc9c8d37` | `anat0m1a/liblzraven@700b88c` |
| LZRAVEN | 131,103 | `0226c649ef454b21ceea88b0b783e429c54204fe63276591ab585fa662118792` | `anat0m1a/liblzraven@700b88c` |

Provenance: [LZMESH native run 42757335827](https://github.com/chriscoveriesorg/applesauce/actions/runs/42757335827), artifact `13736725782`; [LZRAVEN native run 42757335808](https://github.com/chriscoveriesorg/applesauce/actions/runs/42757335808), artifact `13736685663`. All four individual records had independently decoded SHA-256 matches in those workflows.

The original plaintext is deliberately regenerated instead of committed twice. It consists of the UTF-8 row `{"event":"agent","turn":27,"payload":"repeatable proof"}\n` repeated and truncated to the declared logical size; its SHA-256 is `407f35c80eb1f126a7fd05f7245d953481edac539309160a66c183951870e7b4` at 65,537 bytes and `636ffc0a281eef50182e92d90283fc46775bff86ded87703bd02ac39e7c95e00` at 131,103 bytes.

From the repository root, run `python3 hack/prove_committed_vectors.py` for portable exact-byte/index checks. To prove real decoding, first build and inspect the pinned independent decoder separately, then run `python3 hack/prove_committed_vectors.py --codec lzraven --decoder /path/to/lzraven_dec` or `--codec lzmesh --decoder /path/to/port_cli`. The proof workflows now replay both committed vectors with pinned C11 decoders on `ubuntu-24.04` before scheduling the native `xcode-27` Apple-generated differential suite. These portable jobs run the external decoder's unit suite and validate the exact archived bytes, original plaintext and per-chunk/full SHA-256 without needing Apple libraries. The native jobs then repeat the proof on macOS and generate ten fresh Apple-buffer payloads per codec. The workflows retain JSON evidence for the native runs.

Portable hash/index checks alone do not decode the compressed payload. These vectors are **ASCF buffer-codec evidence** and do not establish an APFS `decmpfs` decoder mapping, native filesystem write safety, or FSKit acceptance.
